column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
and a clobbering redirect, which the old row let through
and a redirect with another line after it, which the old row let through
and a write with another line after it, which the old row let through
and dd with its of= after another operand, which the old row let through
and git add -A with another line after it, which the old row let through
and running it on a tab-indented later line, which the old row let through
no shipped table refuses grep -rln over the marker, whose ln is a flag
nor a > inside a quoted log format
nor a find whose 2>/dev/null comes before its -name .felix
nor an ls whose 2>/dev/null comes before the pointer it lists
nor cp reading the marker into a backup
nor dd reading the marker
nor git add -A --dry-run
nor git add -n -A, which stages nothing
nor grep -ln over the pointer
nor listing scripts/gate.sh, which runs nothing
nor tee copying the marker it reads on stdin
nor the read the engine resolves its home with, whose 2>/dev/null writes no pointer
